methodology.intent: Prioritize useful reproducible calendar operations, clear outcomes, source fidelity and distance from existing intent. Do not rank by arbitrary word count.
methodology.demandEvidence: This is editorial relevance prioritization, not a keyword-volume study. Official help coverage establishes supported task behavior, not popularity, traffic, ranking or conversion.
methodology.pendingGate: All final selected source articles have independent approved reviews. Publication and live verification remain separate.
methodology.measurement: After publication compare English Search Console indexed/discovered pages, impressions, queries and click-through against baseline; a few days is an initial crawl check, not a reliable ranking verdict.
methodology.priorityTiers: A/B are transparent editorial utility buckets, not search-volume scores; order within each tier is alphabetical.
